items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: we didn't get the 10 until we got to Dallas and picked up Adam Hardy.

ctx.x: One of him at that time. And he...

It wasn't a very big band there, it was Don Hubbard and his 10 Pals. Well, he put a 10 then. It wasn't even 10 then, we didn't get the 10 until we got to Dallas and picked up Adam Hardy. We picked up Henry Turner, played two bands I've never seen of him before. Oh, well, he was the first one in the band. Yeah, I've never seen a heard of him before in my life.
